name: plugin.ontology_spider
description: Ontology-Spider reasoning plugin bridging Brain Harness Knowledge Vaults via the ModelSource seam for formal transitive traversals, proof explanations, entropy ranking, competency evaluation, and epistemic audits.

entrypoints.name: load_vault_ontology
entrypoints.description: Load Brain Harness vault items, canonical edges, and isnad metadata into an OntologyModel

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Path to vault directory or JSON export

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Optional ISO timestamp filter for bi-temporal edge slicing

entrypoints.name: query_ontology
entrypoints.description: Execute a controlled .dialog query (what is, ancestors, transitive, recommend, path, not, count) over the vault

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Path to vault directory or JSON export

parameters.name: rank_by_distance
parameters.description: Attach hop_distance/distance_score and sort answers by hop distance

entrypoints.name: validate_ontology
entrypoints.description: Run schema integrity checks (cycles, domain/range, disjointness) over the vault

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Path to vault directory or JSON export

entrypoints.name: export_ontology
entrypoints.description: Export the loaded vault ontology to json, dialog, dot, or html

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Path to vault directory or JSON export

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: json, dialog, dot, or html

entrypoints.name: evaluate_competency_questions
entrypoints.description: Run .dialog competency queries and compute the Gruber 5-criteria ontology scorecard

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Path to vault directory or JSON export

entrypoints.name: audit_vault_epistemics
entrypoints.description: Run combined structural validation, isnad verification audit, attribute entropy ranking, and Gruber coherence check

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Path to vault directory or JSON export

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Optional ISO timestamp filter for bi-temporal edge slicing

entrypoints.name: analyze_repo_ontology
entrypoints.description: Extract a formal OntologyModel from a code/research repository and report dependency cycles, hubs, attribute entropy, and unlearned tested projects

parameters.name: vault_path
parameters.description: Optional Knowledge Vault path for gap matching
